subject: Quick technical screen before full demo - ShopHub
body:
From: Alex Kwan <alex.kwan@shophub.io>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick tech screen before full demo

Hi Camila,

We just signed up for a self-serve account and a couple of engineers on my side want to do a very brief (15-min) technical triage before we book the full product demo. Mainly to confirm: model latency with our typical payloads, SSO/SCIM options, and data retention controls.

Can someone do a quick sync today or early next week? We’re based in PDT.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Kwan
VP Product, ShopHub
alex.kwan@shophub.io

---
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kwan <alex.kwan@shophub.io>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick tech screen before full demo

Hi Alex — great to hear you signed up, welcome! I’m Camila on the SDR team at Redwood. Happy to set up a 15-min technical touchpoint with one of our AEs/solutions folks.

Quick options I have this afternoon (PDT):
- 3:00–3:15 PM
- 3:30–3:45 PM
- 4:00–4:15 PM

Or tomorrow morning 9:00–9:15 AM if that’s easier. If any of those work, I’ll loop in Lauren Bishop (our AE) who can run the screen and answer the SSO/retention questions. If you prefer, here’s a direct Calendly to pick a slot: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/15min-tech-screen

Also attaching a short one-pager on our deployment modes in case you want to share with your engineers.

[Attachment: redwood-inference-one-pager.pdf]

Best,
Camila Reyes
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

---
From: Alex Kwan <alex.kwan@shophub.io>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:22:47 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick tech screen before full demo

Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Can we do 3:00–3:15 PM today? Our engineers want to confirm two things specifically so the 15 minutes are productive:
1) Typical 99th percentile generation latency for 512-token prompts on an LLM similar to the one we saw in your model catalog (we can share a sample payload if that helps).
2) Whether we can keep inference logs/requests out of your retention store (need confirmation of data-in-motion vs persisted logs).

If Lauren can join that time, that should be perfect. I’ll also invite our infra lead (cc’d when I book).

—Alex

---
From: camila.reyes@redwood.com <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kwan <alex.kwan@shophub.io>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick tech screen before full demo

Perfect — locking 3:00–3:15 PM PDT today. Looping in Lauren (AE) who will run the tech screen.

Lauren — quick FYI: ShopHub (Alex Kwan) signed up and wants a 15-min triage at 3 PM PDT to confirm 99p latency expectations for ~512-token prompts, and whether inference logs are persisted or can be kept out of retention. I attached a one-pager for context.

I’ll send a calendar invite now.

[Attachment: 15min-tech-screen.ics]

Thanks both,
Camila Reyes
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com

---
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Kwan <alex.kwan@shophub.io>, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 11:00:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick tech screen before full demo

Thanks for the heads up, Camila — I’ll take the 3:00 slot.

Alex — quick note on prep: if you can paste a representative prompt and expected response sizes (tokens), that would help me pull the closest benchmark numbers for 99p latency and outline options (dedicated vs hosted, caching strategies). Also, if you need SSO details I can cover OIDC flows and SCIM provisioning at a high level during the call or follow up with our security doc.

See you at 3.
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

---
From: Alex Kwan <alex.kwan@shophub.io>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 11:06:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick tech screen before full demo

Perfect, thanks Lauren and Camila — I’ll paste examples in a follow-up message and join at 3 PM. Adding our infra lead to the calendar invite now.

—Alex
